projects.title_id: JM-RISE (Jasa Marga Toll Road Construction Monitoring & AI Assistant)
projects.title_en: JM-RISE (Jasa Marga Toll Road Construction Monitoring & AI Assistant)
projects.description_id: JM-RISE adalah platform web enterprise yang dirancang untuk memantau capaian fisik dan keuangan konstruksi jalan tol (Kurva S), kronologi hukum, serta laporan teknis proyek di seluruh anak perusahaan jalan tol (APJT) Jasa Marga. Sebagai Backend Engineer, saya merancang skema database relasional dan membangun REST API berkinerja tinggi menggunakan Express.js, Prisma ORM, dan PostgreSQL. Kontribusi utama mencakup pengembangan mesin ingest AI RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) otomatis yang memproses dokumen konstruksi masif ke database vektor eksternal, membangun sesi obrolan multi-turn interaktif berbasis Server-Sent Events (SSE), serta arsitektur penyimpanan dokumen pada MinIO S3. Selain itu, saya menyelesaikan kendala penimpaan data pada dokumen duplikat lintas aplikasi melalui skrip migrasi otomatis dan rekonsiliasi ID, menjamin sinkronisasi data 100% bagi pemangku kepentingan internal.
projects.description_en: JM-RISE is an enterprise web platform designed to monitor physical and financial toll road construction milestones (Kurva S), legal chronologies, and technical project reports across Jasa Marga's toll road subsidiaries (APJT). As the Backend Engineer, I designed the relational database schema and built high-performance REST APIs using Express.js, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL. Key contributions include developing an automated AI RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) ingestion engine that processes massive construction documents into an external vector database, building real-time multi-turn chat sessions with Server-Sent Events (SSE), and architecting document storage on MinIO S3. Furthermore, I resolved critical data overwriting issues in cross-application duplicate documents through automated migration scripts and robust ID reconciliation, ensuring 100% data synchronization and reliability for internal stakeholders.

projects.title_id: AGGREGATOR OPERASI (Centralized Master Data Management for Toll Operations)
projects.title_en: AGGREGATOR OPERASI (Centralized Master Data Management for Toll Operations)
projects.description_id: Merancang dan mengembangkan layanan Master Data Management (MDM) terpusat untuk menyatukan, menstandarisasi, dan mendistribusikan data operasional heterogen (gerbang tol, klaster, ruas, dan laporan transaksi) lintas berbagai sistem internal Jasa Marga. Menyelesaikan diskrepansi dan redundansi data antar sistem dengan membangun arsitektur Single Source of Truth (SSOT), mengeliminasi konflik sinkronisasi data. Mengimplementasikan RESTful API berkinerja tinggi dengan in-memory caching Redis untuk mengoptimalkan kueri baca frekuensi tinggi dan mempercepat latensi penarikan data bagi aplikasi klien. Merekayasa lapisan pemetaan dan validasi data yang fleksibel untuk menjamin kompatibilitas mundur (backward compatibility) dengan database lawas yang ada tanpa downtime. Menata basis kode backend menggunakan pola Repository dan Service Layer untuk maintainability tinggi, pemisahan tanggung jawab yang bersih, serta validasi request yang tangguh.
projects.description_en: Designed and developed a centralized Master Data Management (MDM) service to unify, standardize, and distribute heterogeneous operational data (toll gates, clusters, routes, and transaction reports) across multiple Jasa Marga internal systems. Resolved cross-system data discrepancies and redundancies by establishing a single source of truth (SSOT) architecture, eliminating data synchronization conflicts. Implemented high-performance RESTful APIs with Redis in-memory caching to optimize frequent read queries and accelerate data retrieval latency for consuming client applications. Engineered flexible data mapping and validation layers to guarantee strict backward compatibility with existing legacy databases, ensuring zero downtime and seamless integration. Structured backend codebase using Repository and Service Layer patterns for high maintainability, clean separation of concerns, and robust request validation.

projects.description_id: merupakan sistem pengelolaan pengaduan yang memungkinkan pengguna jalan tol menyampaikan laporan melalui aplikasi mobile Travoy. Awalnya dibangun sebagai aplikasi Laravel monolitik tanpa titik akhir API, proyek ini ditingkatkan dengan memperkenalkan RESTful API untuk mendukung integrasi seluler. Sistem ini mencakup fitur-fitur seperti pembuatan pengaduan, riwayat pengaduan, dan layanan notifikasi. Notifikasi dikirimkan melalui notifikasi push dan email menggunakan pengirim email, memastikan pengguna menerima pembaruan real-time untuk setiap aktivitas. Dokumentasi API dibuat menggunakan Postman dan Scramble untuk mendukung kolaborasi antara tim backend, frontend, dan mobile.
projects.description_en: is a complaint management system that enables toll road users to submit reports through the Travoy mobile application. Initially built as a monolithic Laravel application without API endpoints, this project was enhanced by introducing RESTful APIs to support mobile integration. The system includes features such as complaint creation, complaint history, and notification services. Notifications are delivered through both push notifications and email using a mail sender, ensuring users receive real-time updates for every activity. API documentation was created using Postman and Scramble to support collaboration between backend, frontend, and mobile teams.

projects.title_id: SIM SEMPRO & TA (Sistem Manajemen Proposal & Skripsi)
projects.title_en: SIM SEMPRO & TA (Academic Proposal & Final Project Management)
projects.description_id: Sistem manajemen akademik terpusat berbasis web yang dirancang untuk mengeliminasi duplikasi riset dan menyederhanakan alur pengajuan skripsi. Dibangun dengan arsitektur Modular Monolith modern menggunakan Laravel 11, Inertia.js, dan React (TypeScript) dengan Tailwind CSS. Mengimplementasikan text similarity engine berbasis NLP dengan tokenisasi N-gram dan Cosine Similarity untuk menghitung persentase kemiripan judul terhadap arsip skripsi terdahulu dengan latensi komputasi rata-rata 41.8 ms. Mengembangkan mekanisme pencocokan topik ke dosen (Topic-to-Lecturer matching) yang menyelaraskan kata kunci riset mahasiswa dengan keahlian dosen dan kuota bimbingan real-time. Membangun Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) pada 4 aktor (Mahasiswa, Dosen, Admin Akademik, Kaprodi) dengan server-side policy guards yang ketat untuk mencegah kerentanan IDOR. Dilengkapi audit trail bimbingan 8 sesi terstruktur, integrasi Google Meet, penyimpanan dokumen privat, serta dashboard monitoring eksekutif. Tervalidasi penuh dengan 78 automated Unit/Feature tests (100% pass), meraih skor System Usability Scale (SUS) 87.08 (Grade A), dan dikontainerisasi dengan Docker Compose serta Cloudflare Zero-Trust Tunnel untuk akses live jarak jauh.
projects.description_en: A web-based centralized academic management system designed to eliminate research duplication and streamline thesis submission workflows. Built using a modern Modular Monolith architecture integrating Laravel 11, Inertia.js, and React (TypeScript) with Tailwind CSS. Implemented an NLP-based text similarity engine using N-gram tokenization and Cosine Similarity to calculate title duplication against archived theses with an average computation latency of 41.8 ms. Developed a Topic-to-Lecturer matching mechanism that aligns student research keywords with lecturer expertise and real-time guidance quotas. Built Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across 4 actors (Student, Lecturer, Academic Admin, Head of Department) with strict server-side policy guards to prevent IDOR vulnerabilities. Features include structured 8-session guidance audit trails, Google Meet integration, private document storage, and executive monitoring dashboards. Fully validated with 78 automated Unit/Feature tests (100% pass), achieving a System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 87.08 (Grade A), and containerized using Docker Compose with Cloudflare Zero-Trust Tunnel for remote live access.

projects.title_id: WORDPRESS MULTI-SITE CLOUD VPS MIGRATION & INFRASTRUCTURE OPTIMIZATION (Freelance)
projects.title_en: WORDPRESS MULTI-SITE CLOUD VPS MIGRATION & INFRASTRUCTURE OPTIMIZATION (Freelance)
projects.description_id: Perencanaan dan eksekusi end-to-end migrasi server tanpa downtime (zero-downtime) untuk jaringan website WordPress bertrafik tinggi (termasuk JatimDaily.com dan 26+ domain klien) dari Hostinger Shared Hosting ke Dedicated Linux Cloud VPS berbasis CloudPanel (Nginx, PHP 8.3 FPM, MariaDB). Menangani ekspor/impor database, sinkronisasi file via rsync/SSH, custom DNS routing dengan bypass verifikasi local hosts, serta provisi otomatis SSL/TLS. Menyelesaikan bottleneck kritis lonjakan CPU Load Average hingga 104+ akibat crawler AI agresif (Meta/Claude/Exa bots) dan unthrottled worker pools melalui mitigasi Nginx HTTP 403 blocking, penyesuaian pool worker PHP-FPM (pm.max_children), dan Redis object caching—menurunkan load CPU hingga < 0.5, membebaskan memori RAM > 4.5 GB, dan mempercepat TTFB dari 40+ detik menjadi 1–3 detik.
projects.description_en: Successfully planned and executed an end-to-end zero-downtime server migration for high-traffic WordPress websites (including JatimDaily.com and 26+ client domains) from Hostinger Shared Hosting to a dedicated Linux Cloud VPS powered by CloudPanel (Nginx, PHP 8.3 FPM, MariaDB). Handled database export/import, file synchronization via rsync/SSH, custom DNS routing with local hosts bypass verification, and automated SSL/TLS provisioning. Beyond migration, resolved critical server bottleneck issues where CPU Load Average spiked to 104+ due to aggressive AI crawlers (Meta/Claude/Exa bots) and unthrottled worker pools. Hardened the server infrastructure by implementing custom Nginx-level bot mitigation rules (HTTP 403 blocking), tuning PHP-FPM process pools (pm.max_children), and configuring Redis object caching. This successful optimization reduced server CPU load to < 0.5, increased available RAM by over 4.5 GB, and accelerated page response time (TTFB) from 40+ seconds down to under 1-3 seconds.

projects.title_id: SIGNFLOW (Platform Tanda Tangan Digital & Verifikasi Dokumen)
projects.description_id: Mengembangkan platform tanda tangan digital dan validasi keaslian dokumen berbasis web yang aman sebagai proyek freelance untuk mendigitalisasi alur kerja penandatanganan dokumen enterprise. Mengembangkan manipulasi PDF dinamis dan verifikasi cryptographic hash guna memastikan keaslian dokumen serta perlindungan dari manipulasi (tamper protection). Mengimplementasikan alur persetujuan bertingkat (sequential multi-level approval workflow), antrean notifikasi email otomatis (queue-driven), kontrol akses berbasis peran (RBAC), dan manajemen status pengguna massal (bulk action) dengan notifikasi modern Sonner. Aplikasi dibangun sebagai Progressive Web App (PWA) responsif yang mendukung akses offline dan pembuatan tanda tangan digital ramah perangkat layar sentuh.
projects.description_en: Developed a secure web-based digital signature and document validation platform as a freelance project to digitize enterprise document signing workflows. Engineered dynamic PDF manipulation and cryptographic hash verification to ensure document authenticity and tamper protection. Implemented a sequential multi-level approval workflow, automated queue-driven email notifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and bulk user status management with modern Sonner toast notifications. The application was built as a responsive Progressive Web App (PWA) supporting offline access and mobile-friendly digital signature drawing.
